# xelon_object_storage_user (Resource)

The object storage user resource allows you to manage Xelon Object Storage users.

Users are used to create access keys and manage access to Object Storage buckets.

-> Creating a `xelon_object_storage_user` also creates one initial access key in Xelon.
This key is created by Xelon automatically because every Object Storage user must have at least
one active access key. Terraform does not manage this initial key: it is not added to your
Terraform state as a `xelon_object_storage_access_key`, and Terraform will not rotate or delete it.
To manage additional access keys with Terraform, use the `xelon_object_storage_access_key` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xelon_object_storage_user" "test" {
  name          = "testuser"
  region        = "zh1"
  storage_limit = 500
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the object storage user.
- `region` (String) The region of the object storage user.
- `storage_limit` (Number) The storage limit of the object storage user in GB.

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) The ID of the tenant that owns the object storage user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the object storage user.
- `region_replication_enabled` (Boolean) Whether region replication is enabled for the object storage user.
- `s3_endpoints` (Set of String) The set of S3-compatible endpoint URLs that can be used to access object storage.
